name: brineprop_secondary_refrigerants
title: BrineProp: thermophysical properties of aqueous secondary refrigerants (function library)
summary: Single EES procedure BRINEPROP of the ULiège BrineProp library: freezing point, density, specific heat, thermal conductivity and dynamic viscosity of eleven aqueous secondary refrigerants (EG, PG, EA, MA, GL, NH3, K2CO3, CaCl2, MgCl2, NaCl, KAc) as a function of mass concentration and temperature, from an 18-term polynomial read in two coefficient lookup tables.
fluids: aqueous solutions EG, PG, EA, MA, GL, NH3, K2CO3, CaCl2, MgCl2, NaCl, KAc (secondary refrigerants)
language_features: IF/THEN/ELSE ladders closed by ENDIF;ENDIF groups
lookup tables read inside a procedure

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory; the EES help file of the library credits its 1997 edition and refers to IIR thermo-physical data but names no person; the inventory attributes the library to the laboratory, J. Lebrun et al.)
origin.ees_version: X7.793 (compiled library stamp $SB1); lookup tables W4.631
origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), Model data bank / AHU_Components, 1997

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the glycol run-around loop reference model of the same library (GLYCOLRECOVERYLOOP_RefSim_EES_Model_SB080116.EES, EES 7.888, inventory TM-0476): BRINEPROP for ethylene glycol 25 % at t_gw_m = 6.324036551 °C stores rho_gw, c_p_gw and mu_gw; concerns the runnable variant brineprop_secondary_refrigerants_coolsolve.eescode (the native file is blocked)
verification.notes: 3 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); maximum relative difference 4.77e-10 (rho_brine_2), from the 80-bit to 64-bit rounding of the hand-decoded Brine1/Brine2 coefficient tables (c_p_brine_2 7.88e-13, mu_brine_2 4.38e-11). No reference variable excluded; the 437 CoolSolve-only variables are the internal variables of the ten flattened property blocks, the selector outputs and the five case-1 properties (a .lib file stores no solution of its own, so the reference holds only the three properties the glycol model stores). The same decode reproduces the CSL-0072 reference point (EG 25 % at 25 °C) to 2.9e-09 (rho) and 6.2e-09 (c_p). The native file does not parse (CS-GAP-ELSEIF-CHAIN).

related_external: glycol run-around loop reference model of the same library (GLYCOLRECOVERYLOOP_RefSim_EES_Model_SB080116.EES, inventory TM-0476): EES reference values for this model
